Chapter 918: Chapter 17: Lin Yuan and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss (Please Subscribe)_2

“Luck…” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

In fact, even if he hadn’t entered the Seventh Realm of space-time, Lin Yuan was already suspicious of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, these two ultimate beings.

Unlike the beings of the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan came from the Main Universe where many supremes resided; he knew how incredibly difficult it was to give birth to a Twelfth Layer life.

Yet, in the Immortal Realm, there were two Twelfth Layer ultimate existences?

If it was just that, Lin Yuan wouldn’t give it much thought, as the Immortal Realm was more than capable of accommodating two Twelfth Layer supremes.

But these two Twelfth Layer beings treaded completely opposite paths; it wasn’t just that they were completely opposite, but their followers – the immortals and the demons – had a sort of complementary meaning to each other.

All demons eagerly devour the flesh and blood of immortals, yet immortals could also consume Demonic Qi. But due to the highly corrosive nature of Demonic Qi, when immortals consume demons, they could easily be demonized.

However, the fact that immortals and demons can complement each other is already enough to trigger many associations in Lin Yuan’s mind.

Demons originate from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, while the immortals walk the cultivation path handed down by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

The fact that demons and immortals can complement each other implies that the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path have a complementary relationship too. Are Twelfth Layer beings unique to their respective evolutionary paths?

Complementary?

There’s only one possibility, that these two Twelfth Layer beings have a profound connection, or they might even be the same person.

“If you want to enter the Primordial Lands, you have to agree to one of my conditions,” said the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, looking at Lin Yuan.

“What condition?” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

If not absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan would rather not fall out with the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

After all, Lin Yuan’s stay in this world was limited; unless he could eliminate the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss once and for all, he’d rather opt for a ‘peaceful’ coexistence if possible.

“I can sense that you haven’t entered the Dao Ancestor Realm,” the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss said: “Not a Dao Ancestor, yet possessing such insight into space and time, therefore I wish to spar with you.”

“Spar?” Lin Yuan nodded, “No problem.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss probably wanted to spar with him to figure out exactly what form Lin Yuan existed in.

Just by feeling and observing, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss couldn’t pinpoint Lin Yuan’s exact location, but to directly make a move would probably mean a complete fallout with Lin Yuan.

So he wanted to use sparring as a form of probing.

Lin Yuan was pretty eager for that as well; up to now, he hadn’t had the chance to cross hands with a Twelfth Layer ultimate being.

In a super large-scale battlefield, Lin Yuan swept through his foes, but those he faced were Eleventh Layer powerhouses armed with Twelfth Layer weapons.

As for Twelfth Layer powerhouses themselves? He had only had a momentary contact with the Myriad Transformation Queen of the Insect Race, but was immediately isolated by the Xuanyuan Supreme.

…

“Where do you plan on sparring?” asked the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Since this was the territory of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, in the Demon Abyss his strength would be greatly enhanced, hence the question.

If it’s a sparring match, it means they aren’t enemies, and it should be as fair as possible.

If it were an enemy, naturally the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss would not give up any advantage, nor show any signs of concession.

“Right here,” Lin Yuan said after glancing around.

“Are you sure?” asked the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

To spar in his own territory, does this Ancestor of Martial Arts have such confidence?

“Sure,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss might be a Twelfth Layer ultimate, but he had no idea about the height of the Seventh Realm of time-space.

It was also normal; while the Immortal Realm just barely kept up with the Main Universe, beyond the Main Universe was the Chaos Void, where many Twelfth Layer sovereigns and even Twelfth Layer Chaos Realm powerhouses existed.

Their understanding of realms far surpassed that of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

If it were a Twelfth Layer Path Splitting Realm powerhouse from the Chaos Void, upon discovering that Lin Yuan’s comprehension of time-space reached the Seventh Realm, they wouldn’t entertain the notion of sparring at all.

…

In the center of the Demon Abyss, in an immense open space, Lin Yuan and the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss stood opposite each other from a distance.

“You make the first move.”

“As long as you can land an attack on me, you win.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss with a smile.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s form shrank to around ten meters, emanating a pitch-black and profound aura, constantly devouring the Demonic Qi from all directions like a black hole.

“Does the Ancestor of Martial Arts truly believe that I can’t touch him at all?” The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss gazed at Lin Yuan and thought to himself.

Yes.

He indeed could not pinpoint Lin Yuan’s exact spatial coordinates.

But being unable to lock onto the exact coordinates did not mean he couldn’t attack.

It was like a complex ant colony; people outside indeed couldn’t lock onto the position of a single ant inside.

They have no idea where that ant is within the ant nest.

But to deal with this ant, one need not necessarily find out its location.

One only needs to completely destroy the nest, and naturally, the ant within will surely die.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss harbored such thoughts, and since he couldn’t locate Lin Yuan, he might as well destroy all the space-time that he could sense.

“Be careful, Your Excellency.” The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss raised his hand, the Demonic Qi surged overwhelmingly, and instantly, a vast expanse of space-time collapsed.

As an existence of the Twelfth Layer, every single action of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss could affect the surrounding space-time, like a fish in water, any flick of its tail could stir up ripples.

Whoosh.

The terrifying space-time vibrations dispersed in all directions in an instant. Lin Yuan, as the target of the vibrations, was also engulfed, covered entirely by the endless Demonic Qi.

Lin Yuan stood still, as all the Demonic Qi passed through him as if it went through a void, immediately surging towards the back.

After the Demonic Qi swept over, Lin Yuan was still standing there; if not for the vibrating space-time around him, it was as if nothing had happened.

“It didn’t have any effect at all?” The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss felt pressured.

The blow he had just struck was only a probe, but it was specifically targeted at the breadth of the space-time dimensions.

In the view of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, even if he couldn’t inconvenience Lin Yuan, at the very least, it should have had some slight impact, such as lifting a corner of Lin Yuan’s robes.

But now it seems.

That blow he struck was probably immensely far from Lin Yuan’s true position.

“That move wasn’t too shabby,” Lin Yuan nodded and commented.

Directly facing an attack from a Twelfth Layer ultimate being, even for Lin Yuan, was a rare experience.

The Seventh Realm of space-time kept Lin Yuan in an absolutely safe state, which allowed him to observe the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s earlier move more carefully.

“Not too shabby?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss took a deep breath, and immediately the entire Demon Abyss began to contract, “Then take a look at this move.”

Boom!

In all directions.

Up, down, left, and right.

Countless layers of space-time seemed to solidify, Lin Yuan appeared as if he were an insect trapped in amber, followed by a series of fine cracks at the edge of space-time.

The cracks rapidly spread, expanded, and split, in an instant enveloping everything before them.

The next moment.

The surrounding space-time shattered like broken glass, and vast swathes of dark space-time rifts emerged, a scene from outside the Immortal Realm. With this strike, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had torn through all the Spatial Layers of the Immortal Realm, creating a huge breach that connected to the world beyond the Immortal Realm.

“Hmm?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss looked again towards Lin Yuan’s previous location, only to find Lin Yuan still standing there, unaffected by the destructive aura of the shattered space-time around him.

This scene deeply startled the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“I have completely penetrated the space-time of the Immortal Realm, yet still no impact on the Ancestor of Martial Arts? The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss confirmed one thing immediately, “The space-time where the Ancestor of Martial Arts resides, seems to have transcended the Immortal Realm, and even the destruction of the Immortal Realm cannot restrain him.”

“This move of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, while much stronger than the previous one,” Lin Yuan promptly spoke up with praise: “You’re getting closer to me now, would the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss care to keep trying?”

In fact, this move of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was still a long distance away from Lin Yuan’s specific spatio-temporal location, but it’s always good to encourage the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“There’s no need.”

“Indeed, I cannot touch the Ancestor of Martial Arts.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss fell silent for a moment before immediately speaking out.
